text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I... lost..." *pant*... Ugh—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Man, that Nishino Flower sure has some 
incredible speed.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows, she might pull off something 
incredible in the Classic tier...! Do your 
best, Flower-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Nishino Flower after 
the race, she was completely exhausted, 
just as expected...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... It was a little rough...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... give you the win. I'm... so 
sorry...
choice_data_list:
That was a great run—we can look forward 
to what comes next!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She showed running worthy of competing 
even in GⅠ races. Today's result was 
frustrating, but she's sure to thrive in 
the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did my running... give you "confidence" in 
me?
choice_data_list:
Of course! You'll definitely win next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much... What a relief—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Her trainer did well to discover her. 
Pretty impressive.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, someone praised you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm glad I worked hard. It was really 
tough, but... it looks like Trainer gained 
some confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to Trainer, my body doesn't hurt 
nearly as much as it did during my debut 
race...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...I was wondering why it had to be 
"now", but...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe it's precisely because... it was 
"now"...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...All right. I've decided...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, about our next target race...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to come back here again. When the 
cherry blossoms are in full bloom...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge the Triple Tiara 
route... I want to run in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route consists of the Oka 
Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho. They are 
GⅠ races that can only be run during the 
Classic year.
choice_data_list: Let's go, to the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to challenge the 
gateway to the Triple Tiara: the Oka Sho! 
However, there was one thing lingering on 
my mind—
choice_data_list:
Was that your plan from the very 
beginning?
Did you have that planned from the start?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who choose the Hanshin JF often 
proceed to the Triple Tiara path 
afterwards. It is only natural to seek 
races of a higher caliber.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, even the Hanshin JF 
was a bold choice for her. Perhaps she 
just kept her dreams to herself, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, that's...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll tell you all about it once the 
Oka Sho is over!"
